name: Smarter Playlist
description: Create dynamic playlists in Jellyfin from rules, similar to smart playlists in iTunes and Plex. Rules are defined as JSON files and refreshed automatically by a scheduled task.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 10.11 support. Fixes person filters never matching, regex on list properties being inverted, MaxItems being ignored, date rules corrupting their own definition file, and a definition forking into two when FileName diverged from the file on disk.
